sections.title: Habitats
lines: Obscured chamber in the Crystal Labyrinth

sections.title: Appearance
lines: A wingless, 30-foot lizard with reddish scales, a bright red underside, and massive fangs.

sections.title: Special attacks mechanics
lines: Claws and bite · Two raking claws deal 1–8 each. The bite deals 2–16.

Fiery cone · The fire lizard can breathe fire at the same time as it attacks with claws and bite. The cone is 15 feet long, 5 feet wide at the mouth and 10 feet wide at the far end. It deals 2–12 fire damage, halved on a successful save vs. breath weapon.

sections.title: Encounters mechanics
lines: Interrupted meal · The lizard is already awake when the party reaches its chamber. It follows if they immediately retreat. If it comes under serious attack, it retreats to tend its wounds.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: One fire lizard with 60 HP. Steady (11) morale. Animal intelligence (1). Neutral. Magic resistance Nil.
Steven E. Schend, Undermountain: Stardock (TSR, ©1996), The Crystal Labyrinth, Encounter 2: Where There’s Smoke, p. 19.

sections.title: Appearance
lines: A tiny, normally gray worm that can change its color to blend in.

sections.title: Special defenses mechanics
lines: Camouflage · The bookworm changes its color to match its surroundings. Opponents take a −6 penalty on surprise rolls.

sections.title: Encounters mechanics
lines: Shelf contingency · When any living being touches an item on a shelf, the spell releases 50 bookworms into that shelf and its contents. Each bookworm has 1 HP.
Rescue the documents · The party has roughly five rounds to save 1d12 parchments, books, tomes, or maps. Of the saved items, 1d4 are in a non-illithid language.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: Unreliable (2) morale. Nonintelligent (0). Neutral. The printed block leaves Hit Dice blank and gives Nil for THAC0, special attacks, and magic resistance.
Steven E. Schend, Undermountain: Stardock (TSR, ©1996), The Stardock, Area 2B: The Study, p. 28.
